units.source_text: 每逢这时节，艺伎、舞女等都要到平日照顾她的茶馆、歌舞乐师家或艺伎前辈家去分送镜饼 [4] 。

en.t: At this time of year, geisha, dancing girls, and the others would all go to the teahouses that looked after them in ordinary times, to the homes of musicians for song and dance, or to the homes of senior geisha, to distribute kagami-mochi rice cakes [4].
